name: runner
description: Run the current file or a project task in its own terminal tab with one key.

commands.title: Commands by File Type
commands.description: Override how files run, by extension: { "py": "python3 {file}" }. Placeholders: {file} {dir} {name} {base} {root} (paths are quoted for you).

cwd.title: Working Directory
cwd.description: Run files from their own folder, or from the project root.

notifyAfter.title: Notify After (seconds)
notifyAfter.description: Tell me when a task that ran at least this long finishes while its terminal is out of sight.
